Exercise: Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up (Lunge style)

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral
- multi_joint

Primary Muscles:

- shoulders

Secondary Muscles:

- abdominals
- hamstrings
- quadriceps
- triceps

Equipment:

- kettlebells

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:
None

Contraindications:

- condition: Shoulder instability or injury
- condition: Lower back pain

Exercise Variations:

- name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up (Push-up style), force: push, level: intermediate, mechanic: compound, primaryMuscles: ['shoulders'], secondaryMuscles: ['abdominals', 'hamstrings', 'quadriceps', 'triceps']

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Single-Arm Dumbbell RDL, equipment: dumbbells
- exercise_name: Single-Leg RDL with Kettlebell, equipment: kettlebells

Instructions:

- Lie on your back on the floor and press a kettlebell to the top position by extending the elbow. Bend the knee on the same side as the kettlebell.
- Keeping the kettlebell locked out at all times, pivot to the opposite side and use your non- working arm to assist you in driving forward to the lunge position. Using your free hand, push yourself to a seated position, then progressing to one knee.
- While looking up at the kettlebell, slowly stand up. Reverse the motion back to the starting position and repeat.
